description: This file contains a collection of functions for managing U-Boot environment variables via UCI in OpenWrt. It includes functions to add UCI configurations for U-Boot environment, system, applications, as well as functions to configure MTD, MMC, and UBI devices related to U-Boot.

methods.name: _ubootenv_add_uci_config
methods.description: Adds a UCI configuration for U-Boot environment of a specified type with given parameters.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_app_config
methods.description: Configures application-specific U-Boot environment settings, updating configuration files if needed.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_mtd
methods.description: Configures U-Boot environment on an MTD device.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_sys_mtd
methods.description: Configures U-Boot environment on a system MTD device.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_mmc
methods.description: Configures U-Boot environment on an MMC device.

methods.name: ubootenv_add_ubi_default
methods.description: Sets up default U-Boot environment configurations on UBI devices, including two partition configurations.
